notes.content: A minimum of fourth-semester competency in an Asian language ( e.g., JAPN 202 ) is requi red for Asian Studies majors. Chico State offers courses in Japanese. Students interested in an alternative Asian language, such as Chinese, Hindi, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, or others, can fulfill the language requirement by taking the equivalent of four semesters of the language from an accredited program either in the United States or through study abroad. Students who have prior proficiency should contact the department for placement information.
notes.contentHtml:
A minimum of fourth-semester competency in an Asian language (e.g., JAPN 202) is required for Asian Studies majors.

  • Chico State offers courses in Japanese.
  • Students interested in an alternative Asian language, such as Chinese, Hindi, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, or others, can fulfill the language requirement by taking the equivalent of four semesters of the language from an accredited program either in the United States or through study abroad.
  • Students who have prior proficiency should contact the department for placement information.
